BLOCKER: AC-3 requires "store registry evidence is present"; neither spec_pack nor design_pack references any store registry artifact/entry — only migration and test files — so AC-3 is unmet as designed.

AC-3 requires "migration rollback requires a verified backup"; rollout/rollback only say "with backup" with no verified backup/restore step, evidence, or restore test — data-loss exposure on 0026 down (guardrail 1).
MAJOR: C-1/C-2 set `tenant_test: 'N/A: tenant RLS migration'` while AC-2 requires rejecting cross-tenant collisions; runtime role posture (NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS) and tenant binding are never proven (CL-011, guardrail 3).
C-5 uses `migrations/0025_...up.sql` as its own positive/negative/tenant "test" with evidence "migration applied locally" — not a fail-able test; AC-3's testability requirement is unsatisfied.

observability_runbook is APPLICABLE but cites only a design doc and a unit test; no runbook artifact, alert ownership, probe backoff/cooldown, or dependency-down behavior (CL-014, guardrail 2 SPOF/alert lead-time).
Guardrail 6: migration-interrupted/partial-apply recovery and rollback verification are not specified; "Revert the change" is not an operable rollback procedure.
`affected_files`, `affected_components`, `risks` are "Not specified" while controls reference concrete files — declared scope and traceability are incomplete for gate review.
MINOR: FR-1/2/3 all map to the same single test file and design doc; per-AC evidence granularity is too coarse for independent verification.
`config_contract` is `{'N/A': 'reuse dispatcher options'}` without naming the reused options — drift risk against guardrail 10 reuse.
`nfr_slo` marked N/A while `nfr: bounded batch` imposes a performance bound with no stated value or measurement.
NIT: `stop_conditions: ['transport implementation']` and `out_of_scope: ['Not specified.']` are ambiguous/placeholder phrasing.
`rollback: Revert the change` duplicates but conflicts in specificity with the design's "run 0026 down with backup" — consolidate to one authoritative statement.
SUMMARY: Design covers backoff, DLQ, concurrency tests and metrics directionally, but AC-3 fails on two counts: no store-registry evidence and no verified backup/restore path for 0026.
Top risks: tenant-collision controls ship without tenant/role tests (CL-011), C-5's "test" is a migration file, and no ops runbook/alert ownership exists for dispatcher/worker/DB failure.
Gate should not pass until registry evidence, verified backup procedure, runtime role posture proof, and a real runbook artifact are added.
